title: US Military had close call after using AI for hallucinated intelligence report
summary: A CNN report describes a near-miss incident in which the US military acted on an AI-generated intelligence report that turned out to be hallucinated, involving a purported Chinese ship. The story highlights the risks of deploying LLM-based systems in high-stakes decision-making without adequate verification, sparking extensive discussion on Hacker News about reliability, oversight, and trust in AI outputs.
